content.comment_body: Hello, similar to my previous post in the German section regarding guidance on recognized issues with [product_name] programming software and [product_name] modules, I would like to gather the observed error behaviors of the latest [product_name] basic modules and associated programming software [product_name] [version_no]. The hope is that this feedback will reach the developers, since well-known errors from previous modules appear unchanged in the new release. Below is a summary of collected errors and unexpected behaviors: 1) In another German contribution on the random number generator, there is mention of an error response when using more than one such block with [product_name] modules. The solution found by [company_name] is that if blocks are triggered with a 10ms delay between each other, they will operate independently and correctly. This, however, means that current programs developed for the previous module generation need to be modified before transferring to the new one. 2) Another German contribution focuses on a reported error in the [product_name] programming software during simulation of the 'operation time counters' block. My own investigation confirms: a) The basic devices across both hardware generations seem to operate correctly. b) All current released programming software versions exhibit a simulation issue where the 'operation time counter' continues adding time after initial activation, even if the activating signal is interrupted. The parameter only updates after a subsequent activation, showing the total time counted during the first activation. c) The previous software version also has this issue, but it becomes noticeable only after a lengthy simulation, such as running for an hour using two 'operation time counter' blocks with different triggers. This likely explains why it has not been widely noticed. Best regards [user_name]
I noticed a difference between hardware version [article_no] and [article_no]. More details can be found here: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are documenting ongoing errors and unexpected behaviors in both the latest and previous generations of [product_name] hardware and corresponding programming software. Issues known in prior versions remain unresolved, affecting reliability and complicating migration between module generations. Simulation inaccuracies in the programming software also hinder dependable use.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable migration between hardware versions, accurate simulation in software tools, and recognition along with resolution of persistent issues by the developers.
